rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Exposes a marketplace of verified business capabilities to AI agents through a single integration. Each capability is scored on correctness, schema stability, availability, and error handling. Covers company lookups, VAT validation, IBAN checks, invoice extraction, web scraping, and translation among others. Agents can set minimum quality thresholds and receive full provenance data with every execution.
